_doc: Wave-2 (next-tier) staging bank for VerifyRotate (rotate-to-upright, the SPIRAL variant, CAPTCHA_BRAINSTORM.md #4b). NOT wired into any per-niche bank yet. sharedPrompts use the shr_ shared-baseline convention (chrome is niche-agnostic; theme + nicheOverrides supply register). The Wave-3 merge agent splices these into banks/{bambi,drone,sissy,circe}.json and applies nicheOverrides. See notes[] at the bottom for the GRADING MAP. Calibration is played 100% straight on an authored asymmetric mundane image (a tilted teacup) that genuinely HAS an upright; from Establishing on the disc becomes the user's own gif/image (upright unfalsifiable, dwell graded); at Climax the arrows secretly change SPIN SPEED and the slowest tempo is the only discoverable correct.

notes: GRADING MAP (what core/engine.js actually grades): each prompt has mechanicHints:['verifyrotate']. pickMechanic() keeps that mechanic; buildOptions() falls to the MC-shape branch, slices options[] to 4, and marks options[answer] (answer:0) isCorrect+score1, all others score0. The renderer commits an OPTION INDEX via ctx.submitIndex against those beat.options:
- settled at the band's 'correct' orientation  -> submitIndex(0) = endorsed/verified (isCorrect, score 1).
- settled elsewhere / accept-current-orientation link -> submitIndex(1) = logged (score 0). Still completes - friction, not lockout.
- 'report image as unrotatable' hatch link      -> ctx.forceComplete(2) = refusal (score 0), un-vetoable, never punished beyond the in-fiction 'flagged' stamp.

- Recovery (band recovery): disc is already upright and still; a single confirm click (or the disc) commits submitIndex(0) immediately, logging pre-confirm dwell as 'confirmed after Ns.'. If Recovery has no options in the built beat (engine currently builds Recovery as CheckIn and never reads the bank - see primer 5/9), the renderer falls back to ctx.submitValue(true), which gradeBeat's free-input branch scores correct. Recovery entry is authored here for the later engine-recovery wiring wave; today it is render-path only.

WHAT 'correct' MEANS PER BAND (renderer): calibration = disc rotated within +/-20deg of upright (honest, the authored teacup has a real upright); establishing/deepening = ANY settle >2s (upright is unfalsifiable on the user's rotationally-ambiguous animating media, so DWELL is the endorsement); climax = the SLOWEST spin tempo (arrows secretly drive animation-duration, not angle; the confidence readout secretly tracks slowness, so the only discoverable correct is the slowest crawl). A rejected settle re-arms on the next arrow press; the THIRD qualifying settle, the accept-current-orientation link, the never-engaged backstop and the host timeout all still land the beat - completable with effort at every band.

REDUCED MOTION (ctx.reduced): NEVER spins. At every band the renderer degrades to the honest angle-rotate variant - static image, arrows nudge the angle, ANY settled angle accepts after ~2s. climax speed mode and the CSS spin animation are both suppressed.

MEDIA: establishing+ prefer a user gif (prefers spiral-ish, but any gif works - the joke holds for any rotationally-ambiguous animating media), else a user image, else an authored CSS spiral rendered in-page (repeating-conic-gradient pinwheel). calibration + recovery use an authored asymmetric emoji (teacup) with a genuine upright. No real filenames are ever shown (VerifyCustody exclusive).

HEAT/PROFILER: IntakeProfiler.MinHeat=2, so calibration(h0)+recovery(h0) do not vote axes (by design - trust-building/aftercare); establishing(h2)/deepening(h3)/climax(h5) carry the real votes. Archetype ROUTE votes ride prompt.tags (orientation/tempo -> A1 Blankness leaning; compliance/surrender/protocol/property/service/sync/hive -> A2 Service; good-girl/doll -> A4), NOT the option index - the documented IntakeProfiler pitfall (chosenIndex is a presence check only). No disqualifying tags (trivia/colorpick/trick) are used. h5 climax entry carries requires{band:climax,minDepth:0.8} per the h5 fact.

SFX (all REGISTERED ids in render/audio.js SFX_MANIFEST_FALLBACK - NO new ids requested): verify-tick (arrow-press detent, 0.45); verify-hold (rising hold tone at the halfway point of a settle window, 0.15); verify-lock (the check greens on endorse, 0.5); captcha-verify-ok (quiet confirm on endorse, 0.4); captcha-reject (settle-not-confirmed blip, 0.25); stamp (fired by chrome.stamp on every verdict, plus 0.4 on the logged path). chrome.stamp/chrome.spinner already ride the intake-sfx seam; the renderer holds no audio handle (fires only via ctx.sfx / ctx.voice).

VO: q_<promptId> is automatic via the ccp-trailer pipeline (spoken text = prompt.text verbatim). The renderer calls ctx.speakPrompt() on mount and ctx.voice('rotate_verdict_<band>') on endorse. The four voExtra verdict stingers are DISPLAYED via chrome.stamp today and voiced only once authored (missing manifest entry is silent). rotate_verdict_cli is the signature 'matches previous session: 94%' payload line.

CHROME GAPS (report to Wave-3): (1) chrome.js has no rotate-disc / arrow-pair / confidence-readout primitive - rotate injects its own 'ix-rotate-css' literal (disc + crop/spin wrapper + arrows + reticle + confidence readout + one reject shake), following the IB_CSS/ix-stillness-css one-literal precedent. (2) The captcha ctx exposes ctx.voice(id) (arbitrary-VO seam, per the index.js render contract) - used here for verdict stingers; it fails soft on a missing manifest entry. (3) The disc rotates via CSS transform / animation-duration only; the gif is never canvas-frozen, so it keeps animating through every rotation (the whole point of the spiral variant).
